book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoose Asaas Xaafida Koyro Kiita

content: Kirstoosa Hawaareta
Hessa gidida gishshas asi wurikka nuna Kirstoosa oosanchchata malanne Xoossa xuura qonccisanaas hadara ekkida asa mala qoodanaas bessees.
Hadara ekkidaytikka ammanettidayta gidanaas bessees.
Ta bolla intte pirdinkka woykko duulata asay pirdinkka ta baggara taas aykkoy baa; haray attoshin tarkka ta bolla pirdike.
«Ta eriza mala tani ta wozinara sidhiza miishshi baa; gido attiin hessa guussi ta bolla mooroy baa» guus gidenna. Buro ta bolla pirdanay Godaa.

Hessa gishshas pirdana wodey gakkontta haara ay yo7okka pirdofte; Goday yaana gakkanaas naagite; izi dhuma giddon qotettidayssa buro qoncce kessana. Asa wozina giddon diza qofaakka qoncce kessana; he wode issi issi asi baas bessiza galata Xoossa achchafe ekkana.

Hessa gishshas ta ishatoo! Ta inttena go7ana mala ha yo7ozan tananne Aphiloosa inttes leemiso shiishshadis; ta hayssa ooththiday, «Xaafettidayssafe aadhdhofa» gizayssa intte nuuppe taamarana malassa. Hessa gishshas intte issaade sabbidi hara as kadhanaas bessenna.
Neni aazan aadhdhay? Neni harappe ekkontta attida miishshi aazee? Histtiin ne wursaka ekkiday hara asappe gidikko hara asappe ekkontta asa mala aazas ceeqettay?
Ha7i gidikko inttes koshshizaaz intte ubbaa demmidetanne duretideta; nuuppeka shaakettidi kawotideta; intte tumukka kawotidaakko nunikka inttenara kawotanakko shin.
Gaasoykka Xoossi nuna Hawaareta nu bolla hayqo pirday pirdettida asata mala asa ubbaafe wurseth ooththidaaz taas misatees; hessa gishshas alames, kiitanchchatassinne asa ubbaas kaassa miish gididos.
Nu Kirstoosa gishshas eeyata gididos; intte qasse Kirstoosan eranchchata; nuni daaburanchchata; intte gidikko minota; intte bonchchettidayta; nuni gidikko kawushshata.
Hanno gakkanaas nu gafoos; saamettoos; kallottoos; bukettoos; aqizasoy dhayiin waayettoos.
Nu kushera ooththi daaburi aqoos; nuna qanggishin nu qasse anjjoos; nuna gooddishin nu dandayoos.
Nu sunth istti moorishin nu qasse lo7o zaaroos; hanno gakkanaas nuni biittafe pitettida buura gididos.
Ta hayssa inttes xaafizay inttena ta dosiza ta nayta mala zoranaas gaada attiin inttena yeellachchanaas gidenna.
Inttena Kirstoosan dichchiza daro asati diikkoka inttes daro Aawati deettenna; tani qasse Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho qaalan inttena yeladis.
Hessa gishshas intte tana misatana mala ta inttena woossays.

Godaan daro dosettidayssanne ammanettida ta naa Ximtoosa ta intteko kiittiday hessa gaasonna. Izikka dumma dummason diza Woosa Keeththa asaa wursi ta tamaarsida timirtezara gaaggizayssa Yesus Kirstoosan diza de7o oge gishshas inttena izi qofsana.
Inttefe issi issi asati ta nam7anththo inttena beyanaas bonttaaz isttas misatiin otorettida.
Gido attiin Godaa shene gidikko matara ta intteko baana; hee baada he otoranchchati haasayzaaz xalala gidontta isttas aaza wolqqay dizaakko beyana koyays.
Gaasoykka Xoossa kawoteththi coo doona xalala gidontta doonappe bollara Xoossa wolqqa.
Ero! Intte koyzay awayssee? Durqqa ekka booyee? Woykko siiqoranne ashketeththa Ayanara booyee?
